Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting bids (Bid Number JA-207652) for Student and Staff Computing Devices. Bidders must submit electronically via iSupplier portal at https://www.dallasisd.org/domain/143 or via sealed envelope to 9400 N Central Expwy, Ste 1510, Dallas, TX 75231 by July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST. The contract term is three (3) years with two (2) successive one (1) year renewal options, not to exceed five (5) years total, with ninety (90) days' written notice required for non-renewal. Required documentation includes Form 1295, W-9 Form, MWBE Forms, and Certificate of Insurance/Bond within ten (10) days of award. Bidders may optionally utilize the Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA) or Educational Purchasing Cooperative of North Texas (EPCNT). Addendum 2 extended the due date to July 9, 2024, and Addendum 1 clarified that delivery will occur starting in September 2024 with coordination required with the Dallas ISD ED TECH department.
